instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a rustic indoor pottery studio. On the left, the woman with curly red hair (R1), wearing a beige t-shirt and a green apron, stands in profile, smiling warmly. On the right, the man with wavy light brown hair (R2), wearing a green shirt and a beige apron, faces her with a happy expression. They extend their arms to clasp their clay-covered hands together at head height. The background shows a wooden workbench with pottery supplies under soft, warm indoor lighting against a neutral beige wall.
